post.summary: Restores a backup zip. Admin only.
post.description:
Every recipe in the archive is added with a new id, owned by the caller, and its photos are checked and re-encoded
like uploads. The one exception: a recipe whose archive id equals the id of a live recipe here is skipped, which
only happens when the archive is imported back into the box it was exported from (ids in another box are
different, so importing the same zip twice into another box adds every recipe twice). All or nothing: if
anything is wrong, or saving fails, no recipe is kept and the photos stored for the import are removed. One import
runs at a time (`409 conflict` for a second). It can take a minute or more for a large archive.

200.description: Counts of imported and skipped recipes.

400.description: Missing `file`, or not a valid export: not a zip, unknown or oversized entries, bad JSON, a newer format version, a recipe that fails the usual recipe rules (`validation`). Nothing is imported.

409.description: Another import is still running (`conflict`). Wait for it to finish.

415.description: A photo in the archive is not an image we can read (`unsupported_media`). Nothing is imported.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

post.summary: Reads a recipe from photos (PHO-2–5). Returns a draft with `photoImageIds` set.

200.description: The draft. `photoImageIds` lists the stored photos in upload order; in `dish` mode `imageId` is the first.

400.description: No files, more than 6, or a bad `mode` (`validation`).

415.description: A file is not an image we can read, including a HEIC the server cannot decode (`unsupported_media`). Nothing is kept.

422.description: No AI provider (`ai_disabled`) or no recipe in the photos (`no_recipe_found`). The photos stay stored and `error.photoImageIds` lists them.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

502.description: The AI provider failed (`ai_error`). The photos stay stored and `error.photoImageIds` lists them.

post.summary: Reads a recipe from pasted text with AI (LNK-3/4). Returns a draft; saves nothing and never fetches `sourceUrl`.

200.description: The draft. `sourceType` is `text`; `sourceUrl` is the given address without credentials or fragment.

422.description: No recipe in the text (`no_recipe_found`), or no AI provider (`ai_disabled`).

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

post.summary:
Reads a recipe from a web page (LNK-1/2/5/7). Returns a draft; saves nothing. A page with no recipe data goes to
the AI as plain text when AI is on (LNK-3).

200.description: The draft. `sourceUrl` is the final URL after redirects.

422.description: No recipe on the page (`no_recipe_found`), or the address is not public (`blocked_address`).

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

502.description: The site refused us (`site_blocked`), the fetch failed or timed out (`fetch_failed`), or the AI fallback failed (`ai_error`).

post.summary: Uploads an image. It is decoded and re-encoded (JPEG, long edge at most 2400 px), never stored as sent.

415.description: Not a readable image, or over 10,000 px a side or 40 megapixels (`unsupported_media`).

500.description: Something went wrong on the server (`internal`).

oneOf.description: Without it the section is the household's choice for the name, else a built-in guess.

text.description: Read like an ingredient line ("2 lb potatoes"); 1 to 200 characters once trimmed.

scale.description: 0.25 to 10; default 1. Setting it for a recipe already on the list rescales it.

BinaryFile.description: Raw bytes in a response (an image or a zip).

ErrorCode.description:
The `code` of an error response (docs/API.md "Errors"). `api_unreachable` and `network` are not in it: the
frontend proxy and browser client make those up. New codes may be added; treat an unknown code as a generic error.

photoImageIds.description: Photo import only: the photos were stored but no draft could be made.

GroceryAmount.description: One amount of a grocery item: `quantity` as a cook writes it (`1½`, `2–3`), `unit` in its short form.

GroceryItem.description: Several amounts mean different units side by side; none means "no amount".

manual.description: Added by hand rather than made from a recipe.

staple.description: Always has it at home: shown, but the client hides it unless asked.

items.description: By section in shopping order, then by name. Cleared items are not returned.

updatedAt.description: Changes on every write: refetch when it differs from what you hold.

scale.description: The factor the recipe page uses (½× is 0.5).

servings.description: The recipe's servings text scaled by `scale` (`"4-6"` at 0.5 is `"2–3"`).

GrocerySection.description: A store section, in shopping order.

displayUrl.description: The print-style rendition, whatever the household setting says; null if it could not be made.

ImportSummary.description: Result of importing a backup zip.

skipped.description: Recipes left out because a recipe with their id already exists.

example.text:
Pancakes
2 cups flour
2 eggs
Mix and fry.

imageDisplayUrl.description: The print-style rendition of the main photo; null when the household setting is off or it is not made yet.

RecipeDraft.description: What the import endpoints return; never saved by them. The client POSTs the reviewed draft to `/api/recipes`.

RecipeSort.description: Sort orders for `GET /api/recipes`; the handler matches the raw string, so anything else is a 400.

plateTreatment.description: Show recipe photos with the print treatment (`imageDisplayUrl`); the originals are always kept.

oneOf.description: Also remembered for the item's name, so the next list files it there.

file.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or HEIC.
